page.layout: One page of paper, blank. Only show-through from the reverse side (mirrored text and an ornamental border near the top). No printed text, no margin notes.
page.notes: The upper part of the page shows mirrored show-through of text and a decorative border from the other side of the leaf. Stains and spots are not printed matter. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
